column9: The reserved-header writer is retained behind PacketIoWriter and now shares sequence/framing state with negotiated compression.

The isolated rejection vector is replaced by the exact compressed MariaDB compatibility envelope while strict uncompressed and outer-envelope rejection stay asserted.
